title: Heavy equipment mech
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
description_text:
Job Description: 
 As a Heavy Equipment Mechanic, you will be responsible for maintaining and repairing a variety of heavy equipment used in construction projects. This will include but is not limited to excavators, bulldozers, loaders, and other heavy machinery. You will work closely with the maintenance team to ensure all equipment is running smoothly and efficiently, and you will be responsible for diagnosing and troubleshooting any issues that may arise.
 Responsibilities: 
 - Conduct regular maintenance and repairs on heavy equipment, including but not limited to oil changes, filter replacements, and tire rotations
 - Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical issues with heavy equipment
 - Perform necessary repairs and replacements to ensure equipment is running safely and efficiently
 - Keep detailed records of all maintenance and repairs performed on equipment
 - Work closely with the maintenance team to schedule and prioritize repairs
 - Maintain a clean and organized work area
 - Follow all safety procedures and protocols at all times
 - Communicate any potential issues or concerns to management in a timely manner
 Requirements: 
 - High school diploma or equivalent
 - Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Heavy Equipment Mechanic
 - Strong knowledge of diesel engines, hydraulic systems, and electrical systems
 - Ability to read and understand technical manuals and diagrams
 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
 - Excellent time management and organizational skills
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team
 - Must have the pre-departure course certificate 
 If you are a skilled Heavy Equipment Mechanic looking for a new opportunity with a reputable company, we encourage you to apply for this position. Our client offers a competitive salary, excellent benefits, and the chance to work with a dynamic team in a fast-paced environment. Apply today and take the next step in your career!
